summary: Risk-on rally is holding into the last two hours (S&P 500 +2.3%, Nasdaq +2.6% at 2:17 PM ET on falling oil ahead of Tuesday's CPI) while Nvidia stays down about 5.5% on the Huang board probe. Since the last update, Eli Lilly was swapped for a Broadcom call (Lilly's $1,400 level may already have broken, which could not be checked); other levels were kept and confidences trimmed slightly. Quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 11-12% on the Oppenheimer $600 upgrade and holding near $500; a break of the ~$505 intraday high targets $515 into the close.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% on JPMorgan's focus list (AWS growth near 40%) as the index rally holds; above $270 keeps $275-279 in play.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan added it to its focus list in place of Alphabet; a break of the 644.54 intraday high extends it.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Still down about 5.5% at multi-month lows on the board probe of CEO Huang while other chips rally; losing the 170.24 low resumes the slide.

picks.name: GE Vernova
picks.reason: Up about 7% on a German wind-turbine deal and the AI-power rebound, holding near the $833 high; a push through $840 extends the trend day.

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Up about 7% off last week's 52-week low as AI chips rebound ex-Nvidia; a break of $320 targets $326 into the close.
